en.headline: Centre for Health Protection reports four new community Legionnaires’ disease cases
en.dek: The cases, involving people aged 66 to 89 with underlying illnesses, bring the year’s total to 182, the Department of Health said.
body: The Centre for Health Protection of the Department of Health said on Monday it recorded four community-acquired Legionnaires’ disease cases between 15 and 21 November.

The patients are a 72-year-old man living in Eastern District, a 66-year-old woman in Tai Po District, and two women aged 86 and 89 living in Central and Western District. All had underlying illnesses.

An initial investigation found the cases to be sporadic, with no epidemiological links to other confirmed cases previously recorded in Hong Kong. As of 21 November, 182 cases had been recorded this year, compared with 167 in 2025 and 135 in 2024.

The centre reminded the public of the importance of properly maintaining water systems and urged susceptible groups, including men over 50, smokers and those with weakened immunity, to take precautions.

zh.headline: 衛生防護中心公布四宗社區感染退伍軍人病個案
zh.dek: 病人年齡介乎66至89歲，全部有長期病患，今年累計182宗。
body: 衛生署衛生防護中心周一表示，11月15日至21日期間錄得四宗社區感染退伍軍人病個案。
病人包括居於東區的72歲男子、大埔區的66歲女子，以及居於中西區的86歲及89歲女子，全部均有長期病患。
初步調查顯示屬散發個案，與本港早前錄得的其他確診個案沒有流行病學關連。截至11月21日，今年累計錄得182宗，2025年及2024年分別為167宗及135宗。
中心提醒市民妥善保養供水系統的重要性，並呼籱50歲以上男士、吸煙人士及免疫力弱人士採取預防措施。
